title: Determination of Maximum Permissible Noise Levels for Construction Work
what_it_is: Determination of Maximum Permissible Noise Levels for Construction Work

sections.label: Construction noise limits and penalties
sections.summary: Noise limits follow WHO guidelines, vary by time bands, require monitoring for large projects, and NEA reviews controls and penalties.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Mr Desmond Tan) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: The noise limits take reference from the World Health Organization's guidelines and are further tailored to local context.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Mr Desmond Tan) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: To minimise noise nuisance to residents, the noise limits are further differentiated based on the time bands, with more stringent limits imposed at night from 7 pm and 7 am and on Sundays and public holidays, when most of our residents are resting.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Mr Desmond Tan) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: For larger projects of contract value more than $3 million or those which involve demolition and piling, contractors are required to install noise monitoring systems, which allow real-time monitoring of the noise levels by both the contractors as well as by NEA.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Mr Desmond Tan) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: For instance, NEA tightened the noise controls and implemented the no-work rule in 2011 to prohibit work activities at construction sites located within 150 metres of residential premises and noise-sensitive premises, such as the hospitals and nursing homes, on Sundays as well as on public holidays.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Mr Desmond Tan) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: The penalty regime was also reviewed in 2014.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Mr Desmond Tan) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: And NEA is working with other agencies and industry stakeholders on an on-going review of the construction noise limits and penalty regime.

sections.label: Penalty regime feedback reduction
sections.summary: The penalty regime has been reviewed over the years and feedback per construction site fell from about 2.7 in 2012 to about 1.6 last year.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Tan
sentences.text: Today, we have a penalty regime that has been reviewed over the years and it has been effective in bringing down the number of feedback as well as enforcement actions.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Tan
sentences.text: So, for instance, in 2012, we saw that the number of feedback per construction site was about 2.7.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Tan
sentences.text: And last year, it has dropped to about 1.6.
